_doc: The `simple` pipeline this project's Kilo agents drove is retired; they are parked in .kilo/legacy/ and no longer load. The current pipeline is `sofa` and its agentic configuration lives in .claude/ (Claude Code). The MCP servers below are still used — bzzoiro is the football analyst's independent source of record, and bzzoiro-tennis answers 402 addon_required, which is why it is off.
